caption: The drawing depicts a short-sleeved dress with a wide neckline, displayed against a plain, light beige background. The dress is primarily beige in color and features an elaborate pattern consisting of alternating vertical bands. Some of the bands display intricate geometric and ornamental motifs in dark brown, white, and reddish hues, while others contain floral arrangements with red, pink, and green flowers and leaves. The bodice and sleeves of the dress contain a denser arrangement of the geometric and floral bands, while the skirt displays a more spread-out pattern, with vertical stripes of flowers and geometric designs. The overall composition is centered, with the dress positioned upright and fully visible from the front. There is a small handwritten inscription below the dress that appears to be a signature.
title: Child's Dress
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
